text:
44/44 unit tests green (debug + release variants), 0 lint errors,
assembleDebug clean.

Two real bugs the tests caught (not test artifacts):
- AuthRepositoryImpl.logout() called Room's clearAllTables() (a
  blocking call) directly inside viewModelScope, which defaults to
  Dispatchers.Main -- would have crashed for real on first logout.
  Fixed with withContext(Dispatchers.IO).
- LoginViewModel.submit()/logout() are fire-and-forget
  viewModelScope.launch calls; tests asserting on uiState right after
  calling them raced the coroutine. Both now return their Job so
  tests can .join().

Design: AuthRepository is an interface (AuthRepositoryImpl does the
work) and SessionStore now also implements a broader SessionState
interface (mutable fields) alongside the read-only TokenProvider from
A3 -- same fakeability reasoning as A2/A3's DeviceIdProvider/
TokenProvider, keeps LoginViewModel testable without a real Keystore.

Needed a plain androidx.activity.ComponentActivity manifest entry for
createComposeRule()'s default test host to resolve under Robolectric
-- debug builds already get this transitively via the
ui-test-manifest test dependency, release-variant unit tests didn't,
so it had to be explicit (exported=true to match, or the manifest
merger conflicts).
